name: recon-all-for-meeeg
summary: Runs FreeSurfer 7.1.1 recon-all on a T1-weighted image to produce cortical surfaces and segmentation for MEG/EEG coregistration and BEM creation.
description: Runs the full FreeSurfer recon-all pipeline (-all, parallel, 8 OpenMP threads) on the T1w image and outputs the subject directory. It is meant as the anatomy step of MEG/EEG pipelines, feeding coregistration and BEM Apps. No options are exposed (no hires, T2 or expert settings); expect many hours of compute and a FREESURFER_LICENSE or FS_LICENSE on the resource. The repository has no README.

inputs.description: T1-weighted anatomical MRI for FreeSurfer recon-all surface reconstruction

outputs.description: FreeSurfer recon-all output containing cortical surfaces and segmentation. Used as input for coregistration (app-coreg) and BEM model creation (app-bem).

failure_modes.message: Please set FREESURFER_LICENSE or FS_LICENSE in resource environment
failure_modes.fix: Set FREESURFER_LICENSE (license text) or FS_LICENSE (path to license file) on the compute resource.
